sources.title: mhaseeb1604/bge-m3-law · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model is a fine-tuned version of the BAAI/bge-m3model, which is specialized for sentence similarity tasks in Arabic legal texts in both Arabic and English. It maps sentences and paragraphs to a 1024-dimensional dense vector space, useful for tasks like clustering, semantic search, and more. Model Overview
